title: Orbit Shader
description: A deferred rendering shaderpack for Minecraft 1.21+ on Iris/Sodium. Features PBR lighting, SSR, SSAO, volumetric god rays, weather puddles, bloom, ACES tonemapping, and scalable quality presets from Low to Ultra.
body:
🪐 Orbit-Shader
A deferred rendering shaderpack for Minecraft Java Edition 1.21+, built for the Iris and Sodium ecosystem on Fabric.
Orbit-Shader provides a cinematic visual experience through a modern deferred pipeline, with granular in-game settings to scale performance from integrated graphics to high-end GPUs.

✨ Features
Physically Based Rendering (PBR)
Supports standard PBR resource packs using a GGX BRDF lighting model. Metallic blocks reflect light sharply; rough surfaces scatter it naturally. Requires a PBR-compatible resource pack to take effect.
Screen Space Reflections (SSR)
Water and rain puddles dynamically reflect surrounding geometry and the sky.
Screen Space Ambient Occlusion (SSAO)
Adds soft contact shadows in corners, crevices, and dense foliage for a grounded sense of depth.
Filtered Shadow Mapping
PCF (Percentage-Closer Filtering) with shadow map distortion produces cleaner shadows near the player that fade smoothly at distance.
Volumetric God Rays
Raymarched volumetric lighting lets sunbeams and moonlight pierce through tree canopies and archways.
Weather Puddles
Rain generates procedural puddles on upward-facing surfaces, adjusting surface roughness and integrating with SSR.
Foliage & Water Animation
Vertex displacement animates grass, leaves, and water surfaces on the GPU.
HDR & ACES Tonemapping
Renders internally in HDR and compresses to SDR using the ACES Filmic tonemapper.
Bloom
Isolates bright light sources (torches, lava, the sun) with a screen-space bloom pass.
FXAA Anti-Aliasing
Smooths jagged edges on blocks and foliage at low performance cost.

⚙️ Quality Presets
Accessible via the Iris settings menu (press O in-game):

🟢 Low — Disables PBR, SSR, SSAO, and FXAA. Suitable for integrated graphics.
🟡 Medium — Enables bloom and anti-aliasing; keeps heavy effects off.
🟠 High — Full deferred pipeline at standard sampling rates.
🔴 Ultra — Maximum volumetric steps, shadow intensity, and bloom for high-end GPUs.

Individual sliders for shadow strength, fog density, bloom intensity, contrast, and wind speed are also available.

🛠️ Requirements & Installation
Required mods:

Fabric Loader (1.21+)
Sodium (latest)
Iris Shaders (latest)

Installation:

Download Orbit-Shader.zip
Place it in .minecraft/shaderpacks/
In-game: Video Settings → Shader Packs → select Orbit-Shader

To use PBR features, load a PBR-compatible resource pack alongside the shader.
